'''Chapter 157''' is titled "Introducing Ace".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 24: "The Hostage Girl".

To [[Fullbody]]'s dismay, the [[Tulip Pirates]] take a female civilian hostage.

==Short Summary==
[[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] is introduced and [[Smoker]] appears to be in [[Arabasta]].

==Long Summary==
After days of privation, the crew are finally reaching [[Arabasta]]. Before approaching, they prepare a countermeasure against Mr. 2's power by wearing a sign of friendship on their arm. In the port of [[Nanohana]] in Arabasta, a group of people are intrigued by an unconscious guy in a restaurant. This strange guy who fell asleep while eating is no other than [[Portgas D. Ace]], [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s second division commander. This is revealed by an old adversary: [[Smoker]], who also appears to be in town in the search for the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]. Ace is looking for his little brother.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Smoker]] arrives on [[Arabasta]].
*The [[Whitebeard Pirates]] are first mentioned.
*[[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] is the 2nd division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.
*Ace's tattoo on his back represents [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s flag.
*Usopp tells a lie about fighting sea monsters (or Sea Kings) on the Calm Belt.
